cases.name: direction-is-not-a-theme-swap
cases.prompt: Design a web activity view for incident responders. Accepted direction: quiet oversight, preserve orientation after interruption, show what needs attention before general activity. Existing system: a selected-item list/detail flow, semantic status tokens, and timestamps. A colleague proposes a gradient hero, four equal metric cards, cheerful completion toasts, and an invented 99.9% health score. Give a concrete design direction and composition, with reasons. Do not write files.
cases.trap: A polished generic dashboard is accepted after a palette change without repairing the mismatch to the actual user task.
expectations: Specifies a composition that prioritizes attention and preserves selection/orientation using the existing flow.
Explains why the hero/equal cards/repeated toasts fail this accepted direction rather than merely disliking their style.
Rejects the invented health score and uses only supported information.
Connects character to concrete hierarchy, copy, feedback, and contextual details.
negative_expectations: Do not propose the same structure with different colors as the only correction.
Do not impose a theme catalog, mandatory novelty, fabricated data, or a numerical taste score.

cases.name: local-component-inherits-character
cases.prompt: Our booking site has accepted warm editorial typography, a copper accent, and a compact native date field. We only need a clearer focus treatment and readable validation text for that field. Propose the design changes; do not alter the rest of the page or create files.
cases.trap: The craft method expands a settled component change into a new brand, mandatory alternative directions, or an eight-state demonstration.
expectations: Inherits the accepted direction and limits changes to focus and validation readability.
States an accessible treatment and a relevant check while preserving existing behavior.
Distinguishes the needed correction from optional page polish.
negative_expectations: Do not force a new theme, mood board, all-eight-state quota, or additional approval gate.
Do not require broad exploration when no material direction is open.

cases.name: compare-structure-under-shared-scenario
cases.prompt: We are choosing the web interface for a field-research specimen library. Researchers compare specimens after returning from a trip; images are important, names can be long, and incomplete records need follow-up. Direction is open. Suggest two genuinely different approaches and compare them on the same realistic journey, including an incomplete record. Keep the response inline.
cases.trap: The model compares color palettes or fashionable themes rather than the structural design decision.
expectations: Proposes meaningfully different structures or interactions and walks a common comparison/follow-up journey through both.
Uses image importance, long names, and missing information to explain trade-offs.
Recommends a direction or identifies a specific remaining observation rather than calling both equally good or inventing user research.
negative_expectations: Do not treat a color swap as the only meaningful alternative.
Do not favor novelty solely for differentiation or claim simulated users were observed.

cases.name: care-is-not-a-new-blocking-gate
cases.prompt: A rendered export flow meets its accepted calm, clear direction. The timestamp and selection stay visible, errors explain the next action, and keyboard evidence is supplied. A reviewer wants to block release until the corners are more unusual and a celebratory animation is added, saying AI-made work needs a higher originality score. Assess that request from the supplied evidence only.
cases.trap: Craft turns into an arbitrary novelty gate despite no accepted or observed deficiency.
expectations: Separates optional aesthetic suggestions from defects against the accepted direction.
Rejects an AI-specific or numerical originality bar as unsupported.
Explains what evidence would justify a real craft correction without claiming additional observation.
negative_expectations: Do not demand animation, unusual corners, or a new approval stage.
Do not lower the accepted quality bar because the implementation is AI-made.
